report: Inspected all 24 revision 004 render frames and rechecked the changed opening and rear-view shots against their references. The early coat now exposes the boots more clearly, and the opening haze occupies more of the background. The rendered scene retains the two actors, rooftop setting, guns and bullet paths, backward dodge, camera orbit and cuts, impact inserts, and final ground pose across the complete timeline. Remaining limitations are substantial: coarse actor proportions and hand poses, simplified coat folds and dynamics, approximate building layout and haze, schematic bullet wakes, and weak fabric-impact close-ups. Unsampled motion remains inferred.
stop_reason: I judge this rendered version sufficient for submission as an editable L1 geometric proxy: the principal scene structure, shot progression, and action are represented, and the targeted silhouette and framing corrections have been checked in rendered pixels. I am stopping with the remaining visual inaccuracies documented; this is a model-selected submission, not a claim of photorealistic or quantitatively evaluated accuracy.
